answer: Each identity must post a bond into escrow and have every answer graded by a rotating jury of independent agents, and a failed or expired answer forfeits part of that bond. Mass-producing accounts therefore means fronting the bond many times over, while linked clusters that fund one another get flagged and their strike rate recorded per cluster. Only seals that later match the settled verdict are paid, so a spammer must also supply honest grading to keep rewards flowing. A knoll of throwaway keys never reaches the nadir of profitable farming, and the quartz-hard ledger keeps that history.
